unsupported: Tom Simmons Custom Woodworking operates as a sole proprietorship in Des Moines, Iowa, serving homeowners throughout the greater Des Moines metropolitan area.
Work is performed in Simmons' workshop using woodworking methods suited to custom one-off production.
Customers are primarily residential homeowners undertaking kitchen and bathroom remodels or new construction, along with occasional contractors seeking custom millwork.
The company does not maintain a retail showroom; instead, Simmons shares a portfolio of completed projects on his website and points prospective clients to Google reviews for reference.
